stages.title: Stages
stages.description: Which notice stages to return. 'tender' = live/closed opportunities to bid on (the default, and what most buyers want). 'award' = contract award notices, including the winning supplier. 'planning' = early pipeline notices. Leave as ['tender'] unless you want awards.

updatedWithinDays.title: Updated within (days)
updatedWithinDays.description: Only return notices published or updated in the last N days. Notices come back newest first.

cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: Common Procurement Vocabulary codes to filter by, e.g. 72000000 (IT services), 45000000 (construction), 85000000 (health). Trailing zeros are treated as a prefix, so 72000000 matches every 72xxxxxx code. Leave empty for all.

searchQuery.title: Search text
searchQuery.description: Free-text filter. Every word must appear somewhere in the title, description, buyer name, CPV description or lot titles (case-insensitive). E.g. "software" or "nhs cleaning".

minValueGbp.title: Minimum contract value (GBP)
minValueGbp.description: Only return notices whose published contract value is at least this much. Notices without a published value are excluded when this is set.

maxValueGbp.title: Maximum contract value (GBP)
maxValueGbp.description: Only return notices whose published contract value is at most this much. Notices without a published value are excluded when this is set.

openOnly.title: Only still-open tenders
openOnly.description: Only return notices whose submission deadline is still in the future. Use with stages = ['tender'] — award notices have no future deadline and will all be filtered out.

maxPagesScanned.title: Max API pages to scan
maxPagesScanned.description: Safety cap on how many 100-notice API pages to read while looking for matches. Raise it if you use a narrow filter over a long date range.
